purpose: Independent descriptive interpretation of all completed locked test summaries using only pre-test frozen development selections. No test-based candidate/checkpoint selection.

validation.scope: Read-only summary identity, records, success-count and pairing checks; parent is responsible for the separate full numerical artifact audit. No trajectory/model inference, training or scored rollouts performed.

definitions.OOD: (C + E) / 2, then tasks equally weighted within each N
definitions.rates_and_differences_unit: fraction; multiply differences by 100 for percentage points
definitions.overall_mean: Equal weighting over 24 task-by-N groups; N levels also equal
definitions.comparison_sign: Exact rational success counts, no floating tolerance for better/tie/worse; descriptive, not significance
definitions.final_system: Frozen development-only choice among B0/P1/P2/P3 plus P4 only where actually trained at N5/N20
definitions.candidate_ids: P1/P2/P3 refer to task-specific designs; pooled candidate-ID comparisons are not one shared mechanism

runs.gpu_time_measurement: synchronized allocated-device wall time; not exclusive GPU kernel time
synchronized allocated-device wall time; not exclusive GPU kernel time

P4_extra_cost_scope.scope: Two independent from-scratch models at N5/N20 using their own fixed D_N; unchanged per-model updates and chunks, additional experiment/search cost. Summed worker active time is not utilization-integrated GPU compute or elapsed calendar duration. Completed debug sessions are separate; CPU audits/design time and other unaggregated work excluded.
P4_extra_cost_scope.feedback_input_accounting: The 200 scored N5 B0/P1/P2/P3 development episodes in the peg feedback packet are reused from the initial development evaluations, not 200 newly added feedback rollouts. The six packets collectively use 1200 existing development episode results and 48 frames.

supported_findings_and_limits: Observed test differences apply to these six fixed tasks, one training seed per model, nested fixed demonstration subsets and the frozen test episode set.
Development-selected initial candidates and final-system are evaluated as frozen; all 72 initial candidate effects, including negative ones, are retained.
IID changes must be considered with OOD changes; results cannot isolate pure OOD generalization from improved task fitting.
Policies use numerical state input; images support agent design/diagnosis, so results do not establish visual policy generalization.
Drawer and door are known cabinet tasks with historical development exposure; coordinator historical exposure limits claims of wholly context-naive autonomous discovery.
No matched human-design or random-search control exists; selected-system gains do not establish superiority of an agent over those alternatives.
P4 is a single feedback-guided peg representation revision with two additional trainings; any test change is descriptive, not evidence of a general feedback or causal mechanism advantage.
Many designs change several representations/objectives together; selected task-level results are not component ablations or isolated causal mechanisms.
Equal optimizer updates/chunk budgets do not imply equal FLOPs; model sizes and active/wall timing must be reported separately.

factual_mechanism_connections.finding: Frozen initial selection chooses action-only P1 with explicit relational conditioning at all four N. P4 changes direct object/goal position blocks to hand-relative coordinates while retaining absolute hand context; P4 test OOD falls by 15 and 1.25 percentage points at N5/N20. This describes the tested representation change, not an isolated causal attribution.
P2 jointly generates actions and future geometry; its test OOD is 25 percentage points below B0 at both N10 and N20. Frozen choices use P1 or P3; no claim that future prediction generally helps.

Frozen choices vary across N: P2 learned soft event conditioning at N2, P1 relation branches at N5/N10, and P3 relational conditioning with joint future targets at N20. Selection differences do not constitute component ablations.
